title: [correctness] Fast marker survives runtime restart
description: Sidecar marker persists while in-memory fastMode resets on restart/shutdown.
fix_direction: Make marker ephemeral or restore/migrate it consistently.
notes: Provider request and UI state can diverge.

title: [architecture] Migrate Fast marker on session replacement
description: Fork/clone/switch do not migrate or clear marker paths.
fix_direction: Treat replacement as a Fast lifecycle transition.
notes: Old sessions can retain stale Fast behavior.

title: [architecture] Gate Agent creation on Fast extension readiness
description: Post-window deployment races first Agent creation.
fix_direction: Await deployment before enabling creation or await readiness in create().
notes: First Agent may not load the hook.

title: [correctness] Reject Fast for no-session Agents
description: No-session Agent has no marker path but can report Fast enabled.
notes: Runtime state promises behavior that cannot occur.

title: [correctness] Serialize Fast marker persistence
description: Map updates precede persistence and concurrent toggles are unordered.
fix_direction: Serialize, atomically persist, then update state or roll back.
notes: IPC failures can leave inconsistent state.

title: [performance] Avoid duplicate runtime refresh on Fast toggle
description: Toggle emits a full runtime state and then queries it again.
fix_direction: Return one state or emit a Fast-only patch.

title: [security] Authenticate Web Fast control endpoint
description: Fast route extends unauthenticated LAN Agent control.
fix_direction: Loopback default, explicit LAN opt-in, bearer auth, restricted CORS.
notes: Existing security issue extended by this endpoint.

title: [upstream] pi-mono extension UI protocol lacks ctx.ui.custom() in RPC mode
description: pi-mono RPC mode returns undefined for ctx.ui.custom() (see badlogic/pi-mono docs/rpc.md). flow 0.14 uses ctx.ui.custom for plan confirm/plan editor/extensions like swarm precision picker, which means in PiDeck 桌面 GUI mode these UI interactions silently return undefined and the corresponding plan flow cancels without user input. As a result, the desktop
modal is never triggered via the tool path; only the /plan-confirm slash command remains.
fix_direction: File an upstream issue against badlogic/pi-mono or pi-maestro-flow suggesting one of: (a) implement an extension_ui_request method

that carries a JSON-serialisable renderer spec (the same protocol used for select/confirm/input/editor), or (b) flow 0.14 should detect ctx.mode === "rpc" and fall back to a sequential select/confirm dialog. PiDeck cannot fix this on its own without affecting the desktop UX.
notes: Verified by reading flow 0.14 source (plan-confirm.ts:38-43) and pi-mono rpc.md. Affects plan confirm, plan editor, swarm precision picker per E:/nvm/v24.0.2/node_modules/pi-maestro-flow/src/tools/swarm.ts:463, smart-search-config.ts:317, extension/index.ts:763,818. /vision and /mcp-auth use select/input which are supported, so the workaround VisionTab and /mcp-auth guidance in PiDeck stays functional.
